user.title: Connect your Garmin account
user.description: Create a personal API key in Garmin Connect (Settings > Personal API key) and paste it here. The key is shown only once by Garmin.

data_description.api_key: Your personal Garmin Connect API key. It is stored only in Home Assistant.
data_description.key_expires: The expiry date Garmin shows for this key. Home Assistant warns you before it expires.

reauth_confirm.title: Garmin key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: Garmin no longer accepts the API key: it has expired or was deleted. Create a new key in Garmin Connect and enter it here.

data_description.api_key: The new personal Garmin Connect API key.
data_description.key_expires: The expiry date Garmin shows for the new key.

reconfigure.title: Update the Garmin key
reconfigure.description: Enter the API key again, for example after creating a new one, and its expiry date.

data_description.api_key: Your personal Garmin Connect API key.
data_description.key_expires: The expiry date Garmin shows for this key.

error.invalid_auth: Garmin rejected the API key. Check that you pasted it in full and that it has not been deleted.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Garmin right now. Try again in a few minutes.
error.expiry_in_past: This date is in the past: the key has already expired.
error.no_profile_id: Garmin accepted the key but did not return the account identifier. Try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant logs.

abort.single_instance_allowed: A Garmin account is already configured.
abort.already_configured: This Garmin account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: This key belongs to another Garmin account than the one configured.
